title: Preparation of JF dye for retro-orbital injection in mice
author: Boaz Mohar

steps.title: Prepare dye aliquot
steps.instruction: Retrieve a 100 nmol aliquot of JF dye from -20 °C storage.

steps.title: Solubilize dye in DMSO
steps.instruction: Add 20 µL of DMSO (Merck MilliporeSigma Catalog #D2650) to the dye and mix by pipetting up and down approximately 10 times.

steps.title: Add Pluronic F-127
steps.instruction: Add 20 µL of Pluronic F-127 20% in DMSO (Merck MilliporeSigma Catalog #P3000MP) and mix by pipetting up and down approximately 10 times.

steps.title: Dilute with PBS
steps.instruction: Add 60 µL of 1x PBS (Invitrogen - Thermo Fisher) and mix by pipetting up and down approximately 10 times.

steps.title: Load syringe
steps.instruction: Draw up to 100 µL of the solution into a 29G x 12.7mm 0.3ml syringe (Ulticare Catalog #09230), ensuring no bubbles are present.

steps.title: Perform retro-orbital injection
steps.instruction: Follow the 'Retro-orbital injection of virus or dye in mice' protocol by Boaz Mohar to administer the dye.
